en: The Triplet of the Wholesome, the Triplet of the Fixed in Wrongness.

Dependent on an unwholesome state that is fixed in the wrong way, a non-unwholesome state that is not fixed in the wrong way arises by way of root condition. (Abbreviated. Three for root, three for predominance … pe … three for non-disappearance.

Dependent on a wholesome state that is fixed in the right way, a non-wholesome state that is not fixed in the right way arises by way of root condition. (Abbreviated. Three for root, three for predominance … pe … three for non-disappearance.

Conditioned by an indeterminate and non-fixed state, an indeterminate and non-fixed state arises by way of root-condition. (Abbreviated. Under root-condition there are five; ... pe ... under non-disappearance-condition there are five.
